beginner.summary: For Python or JavaScript developers and data engineers who are new to Pinecone and want to store and search embeddings in a managed service. Covers the Pinecone console, projects and API keys, the pinecone Python SDK, serverless indexes on AWS, GCP and Azure, the index, namespace and record data model, upsert, query, fetch, list, update and delete, metadata filters, similarity metrics, Pinecone Inference for embedding and reranking, integrated embedding indexes with upsert_records and search, index stats and freshness, the REST API, the TypeScript SDK, error handling and retries, Pinecone Local for tests, and a semantic search capstone.
prerequisites: Writes working Python 3.9+ code with virtual environments and pip, and can read basic TypeScript
Understands what a text embedding is and why cosine similarity measures closeness between vectors
Has a laptop with Python, Node.js and Docker installed and an email address for a free Pinecone Starter account
outcomes: Create and configure serverless Pinecone indexes from the console, the Python SDK and the REST API
Load, read, change and remove records with upsert, query, fetch, list, update and delete in the correct namespace
Combine vector similarity with metadata filters and Pinecone-hosted embedding and reranking models
Build and test a small semantic search service that handles Pinecone errors and runs its tests against Pinecone Local
